title: Vic's Point Blank — Counter-Strike
description: Vic's Point Blank addon that adds weapons from Counter-Strike game series
body:
![vpb](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e919dc4521d3abab8a9315785367376541cf72c.png)
# Requires Vic's Point Blank
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This extension will add all weapons from Counter Strike games, such as Counter-Strike1.6, Counter-Strike: Condition Zero Deletet scenes, Counter-Strike: Source, Counter-Strike: Global Offensive/Counter-strike 2. 
The main goal during the creation of the extension was to adhere as much as possible to the original VPB artstyle.
___________________________________________________________________________________________

**This addon is a port of the original Point Blank: Jelly version.**

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Nido for porting this addon to this version of the mod.

I highly recommend joining Nido's Discord community dedicated to SBW mod:
https://discord.gg/frontlinecombat

I also highly recommend visiting his project page on modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/frontline-combat-pack

Once again, thank you very much!
____________________________________________________________________________________________

[Point Blank: Jelly Version of the pack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/point-blank-counter-strike)
